headline: Punj Lloyd Limited: Cost Auditor Resignation in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Punj Lloyd Limited disclosed to NSE the resignation of M/s SGTC & Associates as Cost Auditors for FY 2018–19, filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, in the context of an ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process.
detail: Punj Lloyd Limited, a large engineering and construction conglomerate, notified the NSE of the resignation of M/s SGTC & Associates, its Cost Auditors, for FY 2018–19. The disclosure was made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as mandated for listed companies. The timing of this resignation - during an active Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process - indicates that the company is in formal insolvency proceedings. Cost auditor appointments and resignations during CIRP are material for stakeholder transparency regarding financial and operational audit status.
